foundational_claims.claim: Symmetry is ontologically prior to distinction.
foundational_claims.meaning: A perfectly symmetric condition contains no internally privileged difference.
Absence is not absolute nothingness; it is a symmetry-breaking exclusion.

foundational_claims.claim: Symmetry breaking produces complementary symmetry conditions.
foundational_claims.meaning: Distinction arises through a relation between complementary orientations of symmetry.

foundational_claims.claim: Asymmetry is a symmetry condition under reoriented observation.
foundational_claims.meaning: Asymmetry is not a separate ontological substance but symmetry encountered through a changed observational trajectory.

foundational_claims.claim: The underlying possibility field is smooth and continuous.
foundational_claims.meaning: All admissible paths can be continuously traced without intrinsic breaks.

foundational_claims.claim: Discrete conditions are indices of critical structures.
foundational_claims.meaning: Discreteness arises through structural recognition, not through fragmentation of the underlying field.

foundational_claims.claim: Orientation and scale can transform a continuous process into a discrete recognized whole.
foundational_claims.meaning: The field remains continuous while a coherent structure becomes indexable as one object.

foundational_claims.claim: Geometry is a projection of a more primitive computational surface.
foundational_claims.meaning: Geometric form is derived from computational continuation rather than assumed as fundamental.

symmetry.definition: A condition in which relations are equivalent and no distinction is privileged.

symmetry_breaking.definition: Exclusion or differentiation within symmetry that produces complementary conditions.

computational_surface.definition: A smooth possibility structure supporting recursive continuation and observational reorientation.

possibility.definition: A preexisting structural potential whose presence constrains future effects even when not realized as a current condition.

trajectory.definition: Ordinal continuation along a semantic geodesic.

semantic_geodesic.definition: A continuity-preserving path of meaning or relation.
semantic_geodesic.constraint: The term is analogical and does not imply general relativity or metric geometry.

critical_structure.definition: A coherent pattern within the continuous field that remains distinguishable under a selected orientation and scale.

index.definition: An ordinal marker assigned to a recognized critical structure.
index.constraint: An index is not inherently a coordinate, distance, magnitude, or independently existing object.

local_rule.description: The same rule is applied recursively from the currently encountered condition.
local_rule.markovian_aspect: The immediate continuation can be generated from the present local condition.

persistent_context.description: The field of possibilities predates and exceeds the current realized condition.
persistent_context.non_markovian_appearance: Future effects remain constrained by possibilities and structures not reducible to the current indexed condition alone.

dynamic_model.preferred_interpretation: A locally recursive update operating within a globally persistent possibility field.

continuous_level.description: The field and its paths are smooth, traceable, and without intrinsic breaks.

critical_level.description: Coherent patterns emerge as stable or recognizable structures.

discrete_level.description: Those structures are assigned ordinal indices under a chosen observational scale and orientation.

continuity_discreteness_relation.principle: Discreteness is an indexing effect of structural recognition within continuity.

local_view.description: Each flow path is smooth and continuously traceable.

global_view.description: The entire flow pattern is recognized as one vortex.

vortex_model.lesson: A discrete whole can be an indexed global recognition of a continuous dynamic structure.

graph_model.edges: recognized ordinal continuations between indexed structures
graph_model.graph_space: a projection of recursively traced relations
graph_model.constraint: Vertices are not assumed to be fundamental objects.

field_interpretation.proposal: Other represented fields may be treated as indexed dynamic maps of a more primitive continuous computational field.
field_interpretation.analogy: A dynamic wind map indexes a smooth flow without constituting the flow itself.
field_interpretation.physics_constraint: This is not yet an established interpretation of quantum mechanics or quantum field theory.

terminology_constraints.reason: It implies an exhaustively realized configuration.
The underlying continuity is not destroyed.
terminology_constraints.prefer: A continuous field is discretely indexed through orientation, scale, and critical structure recognition.

terminology_constraints.reason: The persistent influence belongs to the possibility field rather than merely to stored prior states.
terminology_constraints.prefer: Locally recursive continuation within a persistent global possibility structure.

terminology_constraints.reason: The intended meaning is semantic and ordinal.
terminology_constraints.prefer: Semantic geodesic as continuity of relational meaning.

compressed_thesis: Reality is modeled as a smooth, continuous possibility field grounded in symmetry. Recursive continuation traces ordinal semantic trajectories through that field. Persistent possibilities constrain future effects even when they are not current realized conditions. Critical structures become discrete only when a change of observational orientation and scale identifies them as coherent wholes. Their numerals, graph nodes, objects, and geometries are indices or projections of the underlying continuous computational structure.

limitations: Chat semantic capture is not a byte-exact file replica.
Formal definitions, model validation, and claim promotion remain open.
Physics interpretation is explicitly constrained as unestablished.
